es.quote: To further explore our results, we examined the correlation between the number of thought intrusions (i.e., check marks in the margin, which we thought to be a measure of self-regulatory effort, with fewer intrusions suggesting greater effort) for the experimental group and persistence on anagrams; the correlation was not significant ( r =  -.019, p = .929). ... We also looked at the correlation between number of thought intrusions and number of anagrams solved (an alternative dependent measure of self-regulatory resources); this was non-significant as well ( r =  .091, p = .666).
